facades.name: dolac_pavilion
facades.source: Street View photo of the pavilion's market side (user screenshot, 2026)
facades.look: the white single-storey market pavilion on Dolac: flat roof with a deep overhanging white concrete slab along the top, smooth white-painted rendered walls with a darker grey plinth at the pavement, three wide rectangular windows with dark diamond-lattice iron grilles set in shallow recesses, a tall dark metal double door with a small sign above it reading ULAZ, three small grilled square windows beside the door, no other lettering. The roof slab edge is the top of the picture; draw NO air-conditioning units, NO people, NO market tables, NO trash bins, NO parasols, NO map interface overlay, NO round map icons.
